chief_complaint: Multisystem chronic disease management with advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) awaiting transplantation and high cardiovascular risk
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 100‑year‑old male with a long history of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and coronary artery disease (MI in 2003, CABG in 1984). Progressive diabetic nephropathy has led to chronic kidney disease stage 4 (eGFR <30) and he is currently awaiting kidney transplantation. He has anemia secondary to CKD, osteoporosis with high fracture risk, chronic neck and low‑back pain treated with ibuprofen, and non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy. He experiences frequent emergency department visits (103 of 505 encounters) likely related to cardiac, renal, and metabolic decompensation. Polypharmacy is prominent with 15 active medications, including multiple antiplatelet agents and two beta‑blockers. Socially, he has limited contact and an implausible record of full‑time employment, suggesting possible data errors and limited support.
